title: Hands-on Bread Workshop
description: Participants mix dough, practice kneading, and bake small loaves while the instructor explains the steps used in the workshop.

title: Neighbourhood Sketch Walk
description: Visitors walk between public squares and sketch building details. The guide introduces basic urban drawing techniques.

title: Community Garden Activity
description: A host introduces a community garden and invites visitors to plant seasonal herbs and discuss cooperative gardening.

title: Folk Rhythm Practice
description: A facilitator teaches a short percussion pattern and invites participants to perform it together in a small group.

title: Everyday Market Cooking
description: Guests select vegetables at a market stall and cook a simple meal using the ingredients they purchased.

title: Historical Building Tour
description: A guide shows the main public rooms of a preserved building and explains the visible building phases.

title: Ceramics Studio Demonstration
description: Visitors watch clay shaping, try a simple wheel technique, and compare decorative glazing methods.

title: Public Art Walking Route
description: The itinerary includes several outdoor murals and sculptures with short explanations of their materials and locations.

title: Seasonal Food Tasting
description: The visit introduces three seasonal dishes and describes how each one is prepared at the venue.

title: Neighbourhood Music Walk
description: A guided walk passes several public rehearsal venues and includes a demonstration of local music-making practices.

title: Workshop and Shared Meal
description: Participants prepare a simple dish with an instructor and eat together at a common table.

title: Architecture Observation Route
description: A walking tour compares old masonry details with newer construction in a pedestrian district.

title: Festival Craft Session
description: An instructor demonstrates how small paper decorations are made for a fictional community festival.

title: Local Stories Reading
description: Participants listen to short stories performed by a reading group in a public library room.

title: Canal Landscape Walk
description: A guide discusses the relationship between the canal, paths, bridges, and everyday city activities.
